description: Emergenza alluvione FIUMI 2024 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Digital orthophotos and DTM model of some rivers involved in the flood emergency of May 2023, made in 2024 as part of the aerial shooting campaign commissioned by the Agency for Territorial Security and Civil Protection of the Emilia-Romagna Region.Aerial shots carried out in the period March-May 2024. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Flood emergency FIUMI 2024" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
